agents.label: types-choose
agents.task: Types: mech-id (5 worked, 24 practice; kinds mcq and classify: given substrate, reagent, solvent and temperature, name the mechanism and the role of each species, following the flowchart in LECTURES.md; include the solvolysis question of the past exam, strong bulky bases, weak bases that are good nucleophiles, polar protic versus aprotic solvents, heat). traits (3 worked, 16 practice; kind multi: 'circle all that apply' statements about rate law, molecularity, intermediates, stereochemistry, solvent, substrate order and base strength for each of SN1, SN2, E1, E2, in both 'is' and 'is NOT' forms). sub-vs-elim (3 worked, 10 practice; kinds written and mcq: explain why changing the reagent, the substrate, or the temperature changes the ratio of substitution to elimination, naming the reactions). No mechanisms file.

agents.label: types-rings
agents.task: Types: chair-read (4 worked, 12 practice; kind chair with given chairA or chairB and ask [cis-trans, stable]: 1,2-, 1,3- and 1,4-disubstituted rings with groups of different size, including the five of the past exam's Question 4A as worked or practice items exactly as in EXAM-KEY.md, and cases where two equatorial neighbours are trans). chair-both (4 worked, 12 practice; kind chair with given ring and ask [stable, relationship], sometimes with cis-trans first: identical and different groups at 1,2, 1,3 and 1,4, cis and trans, covering all three relationships: same, enantiomers, diastereomers). ring-strain (3 worked, 14 practice; kinds mcq, numeric and rank: angle strain versus torsional strain, counts of eclipsing interactions, bond angles, heats of formation per CH2, bent bonds, why rings pucker, why the chair is strain free, axial cost from gauche interactions, K and ΔG from Table 5.3). nmr-signals (4 worked, 14 practice; kinds numeric and mcq: how many 1H or 13C signals simple molecules give, which hydrogens are equivalent, what shielding means, and what a splitting pattern says by the n + 1 rule, including the isopropyl septet of the past exam). No mechanisms file.
